স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১) The Coffin spring is primarily indicated for:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option1: Expansion of a constricted maxillary arch
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: The Coffin spring's horseshoe shape, positioned along the midline of the palate, is specifically designed to expand a narrow or constricted maxillary arch. As the spring is activated, it pushes the two halves of the base plate apart, widening the dental arch gradually. It is also useful in cases requiring differential or asymmetric expansion between the two sides. Canine retraction, incisor intrusion, and extraction space closure instead rely on entirely different spring or auxiliary designs

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২) According to Moyers' classification, anchorage based on the manner of force application includes all of the following EXCEPT:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Moyers classified anchorage in two different ways: by the manner of force application, and by the jaws involved. Simple, stationary, and reciprocal anchorage all belong to the "manner of force application" category. Intra-maxillary anchorage instead falls under the "jaws involved" category, alongside inter-maxillary and extra-oral anchorage.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩) The Activator appliance is also referred to as the:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: The Activator is often called the "Monoblock" because its upper and lower components are joined together into a single, unified acrylic block rather than being separate pieces. This contrasts with the Twin Block appliance, which deliberately uses two separate upper and lower components. The Bionator is a related but distinct functional appliance, developed later as a more streamlined alternative to the Activator. A bite-plane is a separate device or feature used to open the bite, not a synonym for the Activator itself.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৪) Which of the following is a passive component of a fixed appliance?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
Compensating extraction means extraction of a tooth in the opposing arch to prevent overeruption or occlusal interference following extraction of its antagonist.
Balancing extraction → extraction of the corresponding tooth on the opposite side of the same arch to maintain symmetry.
Serial extraction is a planned, sequential removal of selected deciduous and permanent teeth during the mixed-dentition period to guide erupting permanent teeth into a more favorable alignment.
Therapeutic extraction means extraction of a tooth as part of a treatment plan to improve oral health or correct an orthodontic/occlusal problem.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৫) Finger springs are chiefly indicated for:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option1: Mesio-distal movement of teeth and closure of median diastema
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Finger springs are versatile components primarily used to move teeth mesio-distally along the arch, guiding them into proper alignment. They are also frequently employed to close a median diastema by gently drawing the central incisors together. Their thin, flexible design allows precise, controlled activation suited to smaller tooth movements. Molar intrusion and buccal canine movement instead typically require different mechanisms, such as auxiliary springs or specific screw designs.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৬) Which cephalometric parameter is most directly used to assess the anteroposterior skeletal relationship between maxilla and mandible?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
ANB angle evaluates the relative anteroposterior position of the maxilla (A point) and mandible (B point) relative to Nasion.
Increased ANB → skeletal Class II tendency

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৭) The labial bow consists of all the following parts EXCEPT:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: A standard labial bow is built from three key parts: the horizontal bow portion crossing the labial surfaces, vertical loops (often U-shaped) for activation, and retentive arms that anchor the bow into the acrylic base plate. "Coil loops" is not a recognized structural component of the standard labial bow design. Coils do appear in other components, such as canine retractors, but not typically as part of the labial bow itself. This distinction is a common point of confusion in exam questions about appliance components.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৮) The wire gauge commonly used to fabricate Adams' clasp is:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Adams' clasp is typically fabricated using 0.7 mm, or 21 gauge, hard stainless steel wire for most posterior teeth. This gauge provides an ideal balance between rigidity for good retention and enough flexibility for adjustment with pliers. For canine teeth, a slightly thinner 0.6 mm wire is often preferred due to their smaller crown dimensions. Thicker 1.25 mm wire, by contrast, is reserved for heavier components like the Coffin spring, not for clasps.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question:
৯) A 14-year-old patient presents with:
Increased overjet of 8 mm
Proclined maxillary incisors
Distal mandibular first molar relationship
ANB = 7°
Convex facial profile
Which diagnosis best integrates the findings?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option1: Dental Class I with skeletal Class III
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option2: Dental Class II Division 1 with skeletal Class II
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option3: Dental Class II Division 2 with skeletal Class I
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option4: Dental Class III with skeletal Class II
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
The findings point :
Distal molar relationship → Class II
Proclined maxillary incisors + increased overjet → Division 1
ANB = 7° → skeletal Class II
Convex profile → supports skeletal Class II
Therefore, the best integrated diagnosis is Class II Division 1 malocclusion with a skeletal Class II base

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১০)  A patient has a palatally displaced maxillary incisor that requires labial movement. Which removable appliance component is most appropriate?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
Z-spring is particularly useful for moving an anterior tooth labially. It is frequently used for palatally displaced incisors.

Buccal canine retractor: Used mainly for distal movement of canines.
 Adams clasp: Primarily provides retention; it does not actively move the tooth.
 Labial bow: Mainly provides retention/control of anterior teeth and can be used for limited tooth movement, but it is not the preferred component for actively bringing a palatally displaced incisor labially.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১১) A clinician wants to expand the maxillary arch gradually and simultaneously obtain some molar derotation. Which appliance is particularly useful?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
The quad helix is a fixed expansion appliance capable of producing transverse expansion and can also assist with molar rotation and buccal movement.

Z-spring: Used mainly for labial movement of individual anterior teeth.
Hawley retainer: Primarily used for retention, not active expansion/derotation.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১২) Effective treatment of an established, likely skeletal, open bite is best achieved through:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: For an established, typically skeletal, open bite, segmental jaw corrective surgery is described as the effective treatment option among these choices. This approach directly repositions the dentoalveolar segments to close the vertical gap where growth modification is no longer possible or adequate. A labial bow or Hawley retainer are removable appliance components with far more limited scope, suited to minor tooth movement or retention rather than correcting an established open bite. Maxillary advancement surgery alone addresses antero-posterior discrepancy, not the vertical open bite problem specifically.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১৩) Which anchorage device is most directly dependent on skeletal rather than dental anchorage?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
TAD = Temporary Anchorage Device
A TAD is a small temporary screw (usually titanium) inserted into alveolar bone to provide skeletal anchorage for orthodontic tooth movement.
Uses:
Intrusion of teeth
Retraction of anterior teeth
Molar distalization/mesialization
Correction of open bite
Reinforcement of anchorage

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১৪) An already-developed (established) anterior crossbite can be treated using a double cantilever spring combined with:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: An already-established anterior crossbite can be treated using a double cantilever spring combined with a posterior bite-plane, one of three listed options for this clinical scenario. The posterior bite-plane disengages the bite, allowing the spring to move the crossed-out anterior tooth labially without occlusal interference from the opposing teeth. High-pull headgear, face masks, and chin cups are orthopaedic devices used for entirely different purposes, such as restraining maxillary growth or correcting mandibular prognathism. This combination of an active spring with bite disengagement is a recurring treatment principle for anterior crossbite correction.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১৫) In Steiner's cephalometric analysis, the mean value of the SNA angle is approximately:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Steiner's analysis sets the mean SNA angle at approximately 82°, representing the antero-posterior position of the maxilla relative to the anterior cranial base. A value significantly above this mean indicates a prognathic (forward-positioned) maxilla, while a value below it indicates a retrognathic (set-back) maxilla. This angle is measured from Sella to Nasion to Point A, three standard cephalometric landmarks used across most analyses. It forms one half of the ANB comparison used to classify overall skeletal jaw relationships.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১৬) What type of anchorage is achieved when two equal and similar groups of teeth move toward each other?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
:Reciprocal anchorage occurs when two equal anchor units exert equal forces on each other.
Both units move equal distances in opposite directions toward or away from each other..

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১৭) Anchorage where anchor units are restricted to bodily movement using multiband techniques is called:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
Stationary anchorage refers to designing the anchor unit to move strictly bodily if displaced. 
Bodily movement provides greater resistance to force than simple tipping movement.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১৮) Which cephalometric finding most strongly indicates a skeletal Class II relationship?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: An increased ANB angle generally indicates a skeletal Class II relationship. Approximately 2° is considered a typical Class I relationship, while a negative ANB suggests skeletal Class III.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ১৯) Which extraoral device is indicated to restrict the forward and downward growth of a prognathic mandible?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
:A chin cup is an extraoral orthopaedic appliance designed to cover the chin. 
It applies direct force to restrict the downward and forward growth of the mandible. 
It is indicated in Class III malocclusions caused by mild-to-moderate mandibular prognathism.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২০) What is the primary purpose of incorporating an Upper Anterior Flat Bite Plane?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
Anterior flat bite planes are primarily designed to assist in reducing deep bite. 
Lower incisors contact the flat acrylic, disocclude posterior teeth by 2 to 3 mm. 
Disocclusion allows passive vertical eruption of the posterior teeth. 
It also helps eliminate cuspal interferences during orthodontic movements

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২১) Which is a major limitation of chin-cap therapy?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option1: It cannot be used in growing patients
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option2: It has no skeletal effect whatsoever
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option3: Its long-term skeletal effect is limited and strongly influenced by growth pattern and compliance
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Chin cap may produce favorable changes in selected growing Class III patients, but long-term correction of true mandibular prognathism is unpredictable because mandibular growth continues.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২২) Which of the following is not listed as a type of malocclusion in the vertical plane in the image?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
Malocclusions on vertical-plane :
Increased/excessive overbite
Reduced overbite
Open bite
Edge-to-edge bite
Posterior crossbite is primarily a transverse-plane malocclusion

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২৩) Which of the following is an orthopedic effect of a functional appliance?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Functional appliances may accelerate condylar growth, remodel the glenoid fossa, restrict jaw growth or alter the direction of jaw growth.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২৪) A patient has the mesiobuccal cusp of the maxillary first permanent molar occluding with the anterior buccal groove of the mandibular first permanent molar. Which classification is most appropriate?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
Neutro-occlusion = Angle Class I molar relationship.
In neutro-occlusion, the mesiobuccal cusp of the maxillary first permanent molar occludes with the buccal groove of the mandibular first permanent molar.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২৫) Which of the following is correctly matched?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option3: Mechanical appliance → Active components such as springs and screws
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option4: Passive appliance → Elastics producing active tooth movement
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Mechanical removable appliances contain springs, elastics, screws, etc., which are activated to produce active force. Passive appliances exert no active pressure.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২৬) A removable appliance is required to close a median diastema using a labial bow. Which design is specifically indicated?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
The split labial bow is mainly used for:
 Retraction of individual incisors
 Correction of anterior spacing
Differential control of anterior teeth
 Retention and stabilization of the anterior segment

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২৭) Which of the following is NOT a limitation of functional appliances?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option2: Inability to produce individual tooth movement
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option3: Inability to use them effectively after growth has ceased
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Functional appliances generally do not interfere significantly with oral hygiene maintenance, which is actually listed as an advantage

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২৮) In Steiner Analysis, what does an increased SNB angle (>80º) indicate?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
SNB angle relates the anteroposterior position of the mandible to the cranial base. 
The average normal anatomical standard value for SNB is 80º. 
A value significantly greater than 80º signifies mandibular prognathism. 
A reduced angle below 80º signifies mandibular retrognathism.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ২৯) What is the primary active function of a Short Labial Bow?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option1: Rapid expansion of the posterior arch
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp:
:Short labial bows contact the labial surface of four upper incisors. 
Closing the vertical U-loops retroclines proclined incisors, reducing overjet. 
It is commonly used as a passive retention element in Hawley retainers. 
It is fabricated using 0.7 mm hard stainless steel wire.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩০) Which malocclusion is a classic indication for an activator?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Class II division 1 is one of the principal indications. Other indications include retrognathic mandible, decreased lower facial height and low mandibular plane angle.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩১) Bite planes are best described as:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: A bite plane is a myofunctional appliance, usually incorporated into a removable appliance as an extension or modification of its acrylic base plate.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩২) Which clasp is a modification of the Schwarz arrowhead clasp?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Adams clasp is specifically described as a modification of the Schwarz arrowhead clasp.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩৩) All of the following are causes of anchorage loss EXCEPT:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Inadequate wear time, over-activation of springs, and poor appliance retention all directly contribute to unwanted anchor tooth movement and anchorage loss. A transpalatal arch, however, is specifically designed as an anchorage-reinforcing device that connects the molars across the palate to resist unwanted movement. It works by increasing the effective root surface area resisting displacement. So rather than causing anchorage loss, it actively helps prevent it, making it the correct exception here.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩৪) Which appliance is specifically noted as tissue-borne when used for retroclination of incisors?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: The Frankel appliance is specifically noted as a tissue-borne functional appliance when used for retroclination of incisors, distinguishing it from tooth-borne appliances that rely more directly on dental contact for support and force transmission. The oral screen, while also a functional appliance used for retroclination, is not specifically labeled tissue-borne in this context in the same way. The Johnson twin-wire and Watkin appliances are instead fixed appliance techniques, entirely different in design and support mechanism from a removable, tissue-borne functional appliance. This tissue-borne classification reflects the Frankel appliance's design, which minimizes direct tooth contact in favor of vestibular shields supported by surrounding soft tissue.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩৫) The vestibular screen is chiefly used to intercept:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: The vestibular screen is a simple acrylic shield placed in the vestibule, positioned to intercept and correct a mouth breathing habit by encouraging nasal breathing instead. It also provides secondary benefits by helping manage related habits like thumb sucking, tongue thrusting, lip biting, and cheek biting. By acting as a physical barrier, it retrains the perioral musculature over time to adopt more normal function. Bruxism, Class III malocclusion, and TMJ disorders are managed using entirely different clinical approaches unrelated to this simple screen device.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩৬) Reverse pull headgear (face mask) is chiefly indicated for:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option1: Class II malocclusion with a prognathic maxilla
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.option3: Class III malocclusion with a retrusive maxilla
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: The reverse pull headgear, or face mask, is specifically indicated for growing patients presenting with Class III malocclusion caused by a retrusive, underdeveloped maxilla. It applies a forward-pulling force to the maxilla via elastics anchored to a facial frame, encouraging forward maxillary growth. This is the opposite mechanism from conventional headgear, which restrains rather than promotes forward maxillary growth. It is most effective when used early during active growth, before the maxillary sutures become less responsive to orthopaedic force.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩৭) The oral screen, Andresen appliance are examples of:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: These three appliances all belong to the functional appliance category, which works by modifying or redirecting the natural forces generated by the oral musculature. Rather than relying on springs or screws to physically push teeth, they alter muscle activity patterns around the dentition and jaws. This makes them especially effective in growing patients where skeletal and dentoalveolar changes can still be influenced. They are removable in nature but distinctly different in mechanism from purely mechanical removable appliances.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩৮) Which of the following acts as an anchorage saver?
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: The Nance palatal arch, along with the transpalatal arch and headgear, is specifically used to reinforce and preserve anchorage during treatment. It connects the molars to a rigid acrylic button against the palate, resisting mesial drift. An anterior bite plane serves a different function related to bite opening, not anchorage preservation. Excessive force and improper anchorage preparation are actually causes of anchorage loss, the opposite of what this question asks.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৩৯) Absolute anchorage, with 0% anchorage loss, is best exemplified by:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Absolute anchorage means the anchor unit does not move at all in reaction to applied forces, giving 0% anchorage loss. Osseointegrated implants and ankylosed teeth are the classic examples because they are rigidly fused to bone and cannot respond to orthodontic force. Headgear, lingual arches, and transpalatal arches are anchorage reinforcement devices, but they still permit some minor movement of the anchor teeth. This is why implants and TADs have become increasingly popular for cases demanding truly zero anchorage loss.

স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.question: ৪০) When a tooth with a longer root area is used to move a tooth with a smaller root area in the same arch, this is called:
স্পেশাল বিসিএস [স্বাস্থ্য] - ডেন্টাল অংশ.exp: Single simple anchorage uses one tooth with greater root surface area (the anchor) to move one tooth with smaller root area. Compound simple anchorage, by contrast, uses several teeth grouped together as the anchor unit instead of just one. Reciprocal anchorage involves two equal groups moving each other, which is not the case here. Reinforced anchorage adds extra support to a simple anchorage setup, which also isn't described in this question.
